title: Which interval can still overlap?
hook: One endpoint summary can eliminate an entire subtree.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary search-tree ordering; subtree size and interval notation.
doesNotKnow: Prune interval-search subtrees using their maximum right endpoint.

misconception: Ordering intervals only by start is enough to skip every nonoverlapping subtree.
objective: Prune interval-search subtrees using their maximum right endpoint.

claims.text: A subtree maximum below the query start certifies that none of its intervals can reach the query. Surviving intervals still need both endpoint tests; a large maximum alone does not prove an overlap.
